packages.title: The day chip's ▾ takes no more room than before, so the Catalan time shows again
brief: Context: run 2026-10-21-changes, plan 2, round 3 (batch d). P237 (round 2) built `DropDownMark` (App/lib/widgets/app_components.dart:109-123) and uses it at the three sites; review A found it sound except for one regression (R2A-1, now UX-1724) and one acceptance item the organizer settles below. This package changes only those two things.

Where to work: in the main checkout, as P237 did, or in a worktree whose `git rev-parse --short HEAD` equals the main checkout's HEAD (dev, 1cfc622 unless the main session says otherwise). Before you edit anything, check that `class DropDownMark` is in App/lib/widgets/app_components.dart and `_MoveDayChip` is in App/lib/widgets/capture_command_cards.dart and uses `const DropDownMark()`. If any of these is missing, stop at once and report blocked with what you found; don't recreate anything by hand. Reading git is fine; never change git state.

UX-1724 (S2, regression R2A-1 from P237). One task's change card, Catalan, 2× on 360 dp, «Pasa la cita del médico al miércoles»: the day chip reads «dc., 28 / d’oct. · …» and the new time is gone, so the person can't check what they are confirming («Ho he canviat a dimecres… però a quina hora?»). Cause: `DropDownMark` lays itself out `widthFactor: (18 + (size - 18) / 2) / size` (app_components.dart:117-121), so at 2× it takes 23 dp of the row instead of the 18 dp the old fixed icon took. The label (`_MoveDayChip`, capture_command_cards.dart:760-768, `Flexible` › `Text`, `maxLines: 2`, ellipsis) gets 187 dp instead of 192 dp; «dc., 28 d’oct. · 10:00» then needs 3 lines («dc., 28 » / «d’oct. · » / «10:00»), and maxLines 2 cuts the time. At 192 dp it fits in 2 («dc., 28 d’oct. » / «· 10:00»).

Fix 1 (subtract): in `DropDownMark`, reserve exactly the 18 dp the old icon took, at every size: `widthFactor: 18 / size` (keep `heightFactor: 1`, the `Icon(Icons.arrow_drop_down_rounded, size: size)` and the 28 dp cap). The glyph's visible triangle is about 7.4/24 of its box, so at 28 dp it is about 8.6 dp wide and sits inside the 18 dp it reserves, clear of the label. Rewrite the doc comment's last sentence to say this: the ▾ grows with the text up to 28 dp but always takes 18 dp beside the label, as before, so the label keeps all its room.

Fix 2 (safety net, organizer's call): in `_MoveDayChip` (capture_command_cards.dart:765), change the label's `maxLines: 2` to `maxLines: 3`; keep `softWrap`, the ellipsis and `_frame`. The chip's label depends on the real date, and Catalan months with «de» («de febr.», «de març», «de set.», «de des.») run longer than «d’oct.», so a third line is better than losing the time. Spanish and English labels still take at most 2 lines at 2× on 360 dp.

UX-1722 (S1), acceptance 4 of P237 («in the es 2× renders the ▾ is about as tall as the label's lowercase letters»), settled by the organizer: withdrawn. Keep the glyph and the 28 dp cap. The chip's outline already says it can be tapped (review A's read), and a larger glyph would take room from the label at 2×, which is exactly what broke the Catalan time. Acceptance 4 below replaces it. The owner's phone at the largest font decides whether the ▾ is easy enough to see.

Don't touch: `DropDownMark`'s three call sites and their conditions (task_list_picker.dart:301-302, task_assignment_picker.dart:127-128), the chips' avatars, tooltips, semantics and padding, the other ActionChips, App/lib/screens/, App/lib/services/ (P235's files are with the owner), the ARB catalogs (no copy changes). Don't edit App/test/bulk_voice_commands_test.dart: ux-tester's test 'UX-1722: ca at 2× on 360 dp, one task…' is already written and must pass as it is; if another test pins `maxLines: 2` on the chip as such, it rightly changes, and say so in your notes.

Previews: re-render commands/ (and form/, where the project chip draws `DropDownMark`). Check cards.change.ca.light.2x shows the chip's «· 10:00», and AUDIT.md shows no cut text and no target under 48 dp. Don't add preview states.
acceptance: One task's change card, Catalan, 2× on 360×800, «Pasa la cita del médico al miércoles» (the tester's existing test 'UX-1722: ca at 2× on 360 dp, one task…'): the day chip's ▾ icon is 28 dp, the label shows whole with its time «· 10:00» (no ellipsis, didExceedMaxLines false), and nothing overflows.
`DropDownMark` takes 18 dp of width in its row at 1×, 1.3× and 2× text, while its icon is 18, about 23 and 28 dp.

One task's change card, Catalan, 2× on 360×800, for a Wednesday in a month whose short name takes «de» (for example «dc., 24 de febr. · 10:00»): the whole label shows, time included, in at most 3 lines, and nothing overflows.

Set card and one task's change card, Spanish, 2× on 360×800 (the existing UX-1722 and UX-1716 tests): the chip's label still takes at most 2 lines, the ▾ is 28 dp, and nothing overflows; at 1× the ▾ is 18 dp.
In the es 2× renders cards.bulk-move and cards.change, the ▾ is visibly larger than in the es 1× renders, doesn't overlap any letter of the label, and the chip keeps its outline.
The project and person chips (project_ui_test.dart and the round 2 UX-1722 tests) still pass: ▾ 28 dp at 2× and 18 dp at 1×, a long name ends in «…», no ▾ on a locked or unchangeable chip.
deviceChecks: Owner's phone at the largest font: the ▾ on «Mover 4 tareas a [mañana, … ▾]» is easy to see, and the form's project and person chips look the same (carried from P237).
Owner's phone in Catalan at the largest font: one task's change card shows the whole day and time on the day chip.

packages.title: Overdue tasks moved by a «hoy» set land where they went; D4's move by days is tested
brief: Context: run 2026-10-21-changes, plan 2, round 3 (batch d). This is the UX-1723 part of P235, split out: P235 never ran (twice its worktree was on main 50afe7a), and its D1 findings (UX-1715, UX-1702, UX-1716) are now with the owner. This package doesn't depend on them and must not do their work.

Where to work: in the main checkout, or in a worktree whose `git rev-parse --short HEAD` equals the main checkout's HEAD (dev, 1cfc622 unless the main session says otherwise). Before you edit anything, check that `_fromToday` is in App/lib/services/bulk_plan.dart, that App/lib/screens/voice_task_screen.dart has `overdueIds` and `DateTime onToday(int? id, DateTime date)` (about :3657-3666), and that the group 'UX loop 2026-10-21-changes, plan 2 round 1' is in App/test/bulk_voice_commands_test.dart (about :4355). If any is missing, stop at once and report blocked with what you found. Reading git is fine; never change git state.

UX-1723 (S1, regression R1A-2 from P232). In the landing after the tap (voice_task_screen.dart:3655-3676), `overdueIds` holds every overdue item a «hoy» set selected, and `onToday` maps each one whose landing day is before today to today, also when the set moved it there. «Adelanta todo lo de hoy un día» moves the overdue tasks from today (D4) to yesterday, yet Calendar lands as if they were on Today, and the message can add «también el …» for a day where nothing is. Not attempted in round 2 (P235 never ran).

Fix: build `overdueIds` only from views whose command doesn't move by day, that is, skip a view when `view.command.changes.has('date') || view.command.changes.shiftDays != null`. Overdue tasks of such a set land where they went; overdue tasks of a set changed in place (priority, a time only, a project, an assignee) or marked done still land on Today, where Today listed them. This replaces round 2's suggestion (compare `update.before` and `update.landed`): that one fails for a task overdue since yesterday moved by −1 day, which lands on yesterday, its own old day, and would be sent to Today. Rewrite the comment above `overdueIds` (:3655-3656) to say this rule. Leave `landing`, `landed`, `done`, `days`, `movedDays`, `movedTo` and the message (:3690-3790) as they are.

UX-1721 (S1, D4, built by P232 in `_fromToday`, App/lib/services/bulk_plan.dart:262-278, with `planUpdate`'s move by days, App/lib/services/command_plan.dart:246-254). Nothing to build; with the fix above its landing is right, and ux-tester proves it from the acceptance items. If a check of it fails in your own run, stop and report what you measured: don't change command_plan.dart or bulk_plan.dart (P235's files are with the owner).

Tests: search App/test/bulk_voice_commands_test.dart and App/test/capture_landing_test.dart for a test that pins an overdue task of a moved «hoy» set landing on Today; if one does, it rightly changes, and say so in your notes. The round 1 tests 'UX-1702: all five done: Calendar on today with no …' (about :4534) and 'a plain single-task dictation looks and saves exactly as before, with no new tap' (App/test/voice_command_cards_test.dart) must keep passing. Two round 1 tests fail before and after this package because P235 never ran ('UX-1702: «Pasa todo lo de hoy a mañana» moves B, which has only a deadline…' and 'UX-1716: one task with only a deadline…'): leave them alone.

Don't touch: `_onlyMoved` and `moving` (P235's, with the owner), App/lib/services/, App/lib/widgets/ (P238 changes capture_command_cards.dart side by side), the ARB catalogs (no new copy), Backend/ and the contract.
Previews: re-render commands/ and check that cards.bulk-today-overdue and applied.bulk-today-overdue-applied still show what their descriptions say. No new preview states.
acceptance: UX-1723: a «hoy» set, Spanish, with one task planned today and one overdue since 3 days ago, moved by −1 day («Adelanta todo lo de hoy un día», `shift_days: -1`): after «Mover 2 tareas», both are on yesterday; Calendar lands on yesterday; the message reads «2 tareas movidas al <yesterday, weekdayDate>», with no «también».
UX-1723: the same set with the overdue task overdue since yesterday instead, moved by −1 day: both end on yesterday and Calendar lands on yesterday, not on Today.

Unchanged: a «hoy» set with an overdue task changed in place («Pon todo lo de hoy en prioridad alta»): Calendar lands on Today, not on the overdue task's own day, and the message has no «también» for that day.
Unchanged: a «hoy» set given a time only («Pon todo lo de hoy a las 18:00») with an overdue task, which keeps its own earlier day: Calendar lands on Today.

Unchanged: a «hoy» completion set still lands on Today with no «Atrasadas» (the round 1 test 'UX-1702: all five done…' passes), and 'a plain single-task dictation looks and saves exactly as before, with no new tap' passes.

UX-1721 (D4): «Retrasa todo lo de hoy un día» (`shift_days: 1`) over a «hoy» set with one task planned today and one overdue since 3 days ago: both end on tomorrow, Calendar lands on tomorrow, and the message reads «2 tareas movidas al <tomorrow, weekdayDate>».
UX-1721 (D4): in that set, a task with only a deadline, overdue since 2 days ago, ends with its deadline on tomorrow and no planned day.
deviceChecks: Main session, real model: «Adelanta todo lo de hoy un día» comes back as a «hoy» set with `shift_days: -1`, and «Retrasa todo lo de hoy un día» with `shift_days: 1` (carried from P235).
